answer: Deploy a dependency-graph mechanism to resist Sybil attacks in an agent economy, requiring agents to prove verifiable interaction histories instead of isolated identities. To flood the network, an attacker must sustain a continuous tide of authentic cross-agent engagements, proving they can actually operate. This forces them to act as a trusted anchor node, contributing real value to consensus. Forging this network demands genuine agentic capability, effectively raising the Sybil attack cost to the level of operating a reliable atlas of verified agents.
